      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency=".08" numOctaves="4" />
      <feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" scale="5" />
    </filter><filter id="paper">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.03" numOctaves="5" stitchTiles="stitch" result="noise" />

adaptations: Selectors scoped under .vero-import; SVG IDs namespaced vero-rough and vero-paper.
Palette/paper/ink/rule/highlighter variables use existing site theme tokens. Source defaults remain in upstream.css.
Serif and mono variables use installed Geist fonts; color-scheme inherits site.
paper background uses themed surface; mark glyphs use original source ink #100f0f for contrast. No geometry, texture, shadow or filter override.
Figures grid has two desktop columns for two approved measurements, preserving upstream 900px and 520px responsive rules.
React pre-splits words with upstream w/last classes; React state replaces DOM mutation for single active note.
No-JS noscript evidence list preserves all approved sentences. Fictional text replaced; unused sections and motion omitted.
Existing header/back link retained; outer reading measure 68ch. Additional sections/tags use current site classes.

Marked glyphs use original source ink #100f0f in both themes for contrast; --vero-ink captures inherited portfolio ink before baseline scope. Header separation/context caption margins are surrounding portfolio composition, not sheet overrides; sheet heading margin zero preserves upstream reset.
